summary: Most World calls in item_facts.py are legitimate storygame clients: they format prompts, resolve story names, apply model output, or combine world state with StoryPackage scenes and NPC metadata. Four functions contain extractable world-only logic: a manual parent climb, a direct under-content query, a visible-seat selection that duplicates World.seats, and companion/current-parent filtering. The proposed extractions must preserve ordering, cycle/None handling, under versus on/in relations, vehicle seats, companions, and the timing of fact effects. No direct wk_ predicate reads occur in this file; state is accessed through World and the storygame facts backend passed to it.
